name: takeon
description: TakeOn — modular isometric voxel rover game for the Star Sailors ecosystem. Standalone or embeddable (PixiJS/Landnam).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @takeon/engine && npm run build -w @takeon/pixi && npm run build -w @takeon/ui && npm run build -w @takeon/editor && npm run build -w takeon-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @takeon/engine && npm run test -w @takeon/ui
